name: unm-plugin-generic-ipmi
description: UnifiedNetworkManager plugin for generic IPMI 2.0 (RMCP+) baseboards — chassis power state + sensor/FRU/SEL monitoring over a self-contained TypeScript RMCP+ client (RAKP auth, AES-CBC payload encryption; the password never touches argv), plus plan-gated power/boot control and a Serial-over-LAN console.
